metadata.title: JPMorgan starts Palantir at Overweight, calls it a disruptive AI leader

content.text:
Investing.com -- JPMorgan has initiated coverage of Palantir Technologies with an Overweight rating and a December 2027 price target of $262 per share, also adding the stock to its Analyst Focus List.
Analyst Brian Essex told clients in a note that enterprises are moving from figuring out how to deploy AI to seeking returns on it, and Palantir is already delivering.
"Palantir is already delivering ROI by leveraging its platform to fundamentally transform the business operations of its customers, and growth is accelerating," Essex wrote.
JPMorgan also pointed to accelerating demand for AI sovereignty, which it said covers not just data but also logic, intellectual property, processes, outcomes and security.
"Palantir enables Enterprise and Government organizations to secure and own their means of production and services, or their alpha and value creation," the analyst said.
Despite Palantir's scale, revenue growth accelerated for the 12th straight quarter to 93% year over year last quarter. Non-GAAP operating margin expanded to 62%, and free cash flow grew 126%.
JPMorgan said the valuation is reasonable given what it called uniquely profitable hyper-growth. The $262 target reflects 55 times its 2028 EV/free cash flow estimate on $11.7 billion of free cash flow. The bank forecasts a three-year free cash flow growth rate of 77% through 2028.
The bank also placed Palantir on Positive Catalyst Watch ahead of its earnings on Nov. 2. While its third-quarter estimates are broadly in line with consensus, Essex sees potential for meaningful upside with execution.
